title: Elyse Montclaire - Fully Voiced Troth SkyrimNet Breton Follower
tagline: Elyse Montclaire, a disgraced Breton noble turned adept Destruction Mage, seeks redemption and knowledge in Skyrim. With ice and lightning spells, she strategically exploits enemies' weaknesses. Her elegant yet determined pursuit of justice offers a compelling ally in both social settings and combat. Fully voiced and SN ready.
description:
E L Y S E M O N T C L A I R E
"In exile, you find your true self."

Elyse Montclaire is a calculating, determined, and serene follower whose exile has transformed her into a seeker of arcane mysteries and her family's redemption.

Once a promising diplomat from High Rock, Elyse's life took an unexpected turn when scandal forced her into the wilds of Skyrim. As an adept Destruction Mage, her tactical approach and steadfast composure under pressure make her a compelling ally on any adventure. Join Elyse on her journey to clear her name and regain her family's honor.

Patreon * Discord
[size=7]A WinterishClover Follower[/size]



DESTRUCTION MAGE * BRETON NOBLE * TROTH FRAMEWORK * STRATEGIC PARTNER


Personality, Dialogue and Romance
She is not naive. She is not someone who brawls mindlessly. Elyse is intelligent, serene, and diplomatic, with a resolve as fierce as any Nord warrior. Her quiet elegance may deceive others into underestimating her, but make no mistake, she is always aware, always plotting her next move.

Elyse Montclaire comes with about 177 lines of dialogue from dynamic passive dialogue based on your bond to her, quest awareness, location and weather awareness, and combat dialogue. As you spend time with Elyse Montclaire, she'll open up more about who she is and her history, ultimately unlocking a romance with her.

Growing Her Bond
With Troth, dialogue isn't the only way to increase your bond with Elyse Montclaire. By doing activities she likes (and avoiding the ones she doesn't), your bond will grow naturally.
Likes: Books Read, Spells Learned, Quests Completed, Skill Books Read
Dislikes: Diseases Contracted, Brawls Won

What You Get
Destruction Mage archetype — adept in ice and lightning spells
ESL-flagged (ESPFE) — won't take up a full plugin slot in your load order
3BA body
High-quality visual assets: High Poly Head by KouLeifoh
Customizable with Bodyslide and Outfit Studio
Fully immersed in the Troth follower framework

Combat
Elyse Montclaire is a Destruction Mage archetype — she'll choose to use her spells over hand-to-hand combat.

Where to Find Her
You'll find Elyse Montclaire near Bits & Pieces in Solitude or at The Winking Skeever, harmonizing her past with her uncertain present. She stands poised to reclaim her narrative in the fortified charm of Skyrim's capital.

Optional Outfit (SPID)
Optional SPID armor/clothing file included if you'd like to use the outfit shown in the screenshots. Required: DDV - Elanors Arcane Grace Dress Cbbe 3BA SMP, 3BA, High Heels Sound replacement, and Spell Perk Item Distributor.

About Troth
This follower runs on Troth, a shared companion bond framework required by every WinterishClover follower. Troth tracks your relationship with her over time — purely through play, no dialogue grinding or busywork required — and unlocks deeper conversation and content as your bond grows, from first meeting through to her closest tier.

Troth includes a lightweight SkyUI MCM page where you can check your current standing with her at a glance. It's a single shared framework rather than something built into each follower individually, so it only ever needs to be installed once no matter how many WinterishClover followers you're running.

Installation
Install via mod manager; the FOMOD installer allows optional components to be chosen independently. It's recommended to start a new game or use a save where Elyse hasn't been loaded before for the best experience.

Requirements
- Troth — Follower Relationship Framework (required)
- 3BA — the body this follower uses

Recommended Mods
- Nether's Follower Framework — recommended for marriage (Elope option) and deeper follower management

FAQ
Q. Can you make an "insert body mod" version?
A. No, she's always going to be 3BA, but conversions are allowed with permission.

Q. I have a problem — where should I get help?
A. Comments section or join the Discord.

Q. Can you replace the generated voice with a human one?
A. Possibly — I have interest in doing this for some of my followers. We'll see which ones when the work is complete. Until then she's going to use a generated voice.

Q. Can I marry her?
A. Yes but you'll need to use a Marry Anyone mod or use Nether's Follower Framework's Elope option. No vanilla marriage system is enabled.

Final Word
Take Elyse with you for her wisdom. Take her with you for her spells. Take her with you for the alliances she knows will be your currency. If you enjoyed your journey together, please endorse her on Nexus and consider supporting me on Patreon for future follower development.
